summary: Site rules become authored records with a closed effect vocabulary that Battle applies at the round boundary, PR #2's five Ayla skills are re-landed on the current engine, Deny Activation and Override Tomb Rule land on the site-rule seam, and content/characters/ayla.json plus her seven skill records ship.

coordination.notes: Branched from origin/backend/b0-expedition-state at cb4f57e. PR #2 (feature/ayla-bridge-art) cannot merge -- A5, A6 and A10 rewrote battle.rs under it -- so its diff is the specification and its eight tests are re-landed on the current engine with the current fixture. Lane S16 owns strategy/production.rs, tick.rs and building.rs and none of the three is touched here. expedition.rs takes two appended fields plus their initialisers at the end of new() and nothing else at that tail. Merged origin/backend/b0-expedition-state at 4906e6f mid-lane (C15 landed): four conflicts, all keep-both -- placeholders.json (C15's Thunderback beside A7's two Ayla entries), build-content-bundle.mjs (habitats and site_rules are separate domains), validate.mjs (one console.log counting both), and the generated bundle, regenerated. At the coordinator's request and in the same commit as the battle.rs work, C15's rename was finished: the vertical-slice fixture's hostile literal enemy.raptor.razorbeak.prototype became enemy.raptor.razorbeak in battle.rs, expedition.rs, habitat.rs, protocol.rs, tests/vertical_slice.rs, battle_prototype.gd, battle_3d_staging.gd, mock_simulation_port.gd and five game/tests suites. loot.razorbeak.prototype is a loot-table ID and is untouched. Three files outside the card's list were touched and are named here rather than left silent: game/scripts/simulation/native_expedition_port.gd forwards the site-rule records and each cell's dungeonContext (without it the engine fights under no rules while the harness fights under the tomb's -- the exact drift B15 and B16 closed for factions and buildings); game/scripts/battle/targeting_session.gd and its suite gain Reach Counter's target rule, because validate.mjs's supportedTargetRules asserts that every rule in it has real Godot targeting behaviour and adding one without the arm would have made that assertion false. content/presentation/{camera,vfx}.registry.json gain ten entries each because every existing camera names Betty as a focus subject or lead and every existing VFX carries her teal/gold/bronze palette; Ayla's VFX carry the single palette entry palette_unestablished_pending_ayla_identity_lock and no colour is named for her anywhere. B17's prototype_vertical_slice_from_bond_ranks is replaced, not duplicated, by prototype_vertical_slice_from_campaign(&CampaignBattleSetup): one campaign-shaped constructor carrying four campaign facts instead of one, with all five call sites repaired.
